title: Asmongold Considers Twitch Exit: Destiny warns it’s Hasan’s dream; Rumble, Kick and YouTube loom
summary_full: Asmongold is considering leaving Twitch if he receives another suspension after his recent 14-day ban. Destiny reacted to the possibility by saying it would be “Hasan’s dream,” arguing that Hasan could gain “sole reign” over the platform. Asmongold has mentioned Kick, Rumble and YouTube as possible alternatives, but he has not confirmed that he is leaving Twitch.
